highlight.note: On load the selection is the whole organisation: the breadcrumb and the conversation say so.
Select a division header, a project's name or an employee chip. The selected card gains a blue ring.

highlight.selector: nav[aria-label='Where you are'], button[aria-label^='Where you are']
highlight.note: The breadcrumb becomes the trail: Northwind / Technologies / Court booking. Every step but the last selects that level.
The conversation re-scopes to what is selected, and the shortcut row follows it.
The organisation's name in the band selects everything again.

variations.title: An app cannot be selected: its name opens its page

highlight.note: An app row is a link to the app's page, not a selection: the conversation is never scoped to an app from home.
